name: 按库存生产 – 离散制造 (7UV)
description_en_html:
Overview

This scope item enables production planning in a discrete industries make-to-stock scenario

The process starts with the creation of a demand forecast for finished goods represented by Planned Independent Requirements (PIRs). Based on PIRs, Material Requirements Planning (MRP) creates a production plan for finished goods and explodes the entire bill of material structure. As a result, semifinished component production and raw material demand is planned. Production planners can analyze the results within alert monitor and manually reschedule the planned order-based production plan according to delay and capacity situation.

Raw material demand leads to purchase requisitions to trigger external procurement.

Production planners can analyze and perform interactive planning for important products that you wish to plan manually or to solve any planning problems that have arisen during automatic planning. In order to resolve the bottlenecks due to capacity constraints the production planners can select among different Alternative resources for order processing or choose an another source of supply. You can use the Alert Monitor to monitor alerts for ePPDS by defining a ePPDS alert profile containing a user-specific selection of alerts that are relevant for your planning area

The planning process itself is entirely covered until the hand-over to shop floor by using the conversion of planned into production orders.

Key Process Flow

  • Process planned independent requirements

  • Execute material requirements planning and evaluation of alert monitor

  • Manual reschedule of orders based on delays and capacity situation

  • Order conversion of planned orders to production orders

Business Benefits

  • Enable automatic creation of multi-level production plan

  • Monitoring of production plan with regards to delays and capacity situation using alert monitor

  • Support planner in terms of manual plan adjustments

description_zh_html:
概览

此范围项目支持离散行业按库存生产场景中的生产计划。

此流程开始于创建由计划独立需求 (PIR) 表示的成品需求预测。基于 PIR，物料需求计划 (MRP) 为成品创建生产计划并展开整个物料清单结构。因此，将计划半成品组件生产和原材料需求。生产计划员可以在警报监控器中分析结果，并根据延迟和产能情况手动重新计划计划基于订单的生产计划。

原材料需求导致采购申请触发外部采购。

生产计划员可以分析和执行您希望手动计划的重要产品的交互计划，或解决自动计划期间出现的任何计划问题。要解决产能约束导致的瓶颈，生产计划员可以在不同的备选资源中选择用于订单处理或选择其他供货源。您可以使用警报监控器通过定义包含与计划范围相关的用户特定警报选择的 ePPDS 警报参数文件来监控 ePPDS 的警报

通过使用计划订单到生产订单的转换，计划流程本身将完全涵盖到移交至车间之前。

关键流程流

  • 处理计划独立需求

  • 执行物料需求计划和警报监控器评估

  • 根据延迟和产能情况，手动重新计划订单

  • 计划订单到生产订单的订单转换

业务优势

  • 启用自动创建多级生产计划

  • 使用警报监控器监控有关延迟和产能情况的生产计划。

  • 支持计划员进行手动计划调整
